name: vizflow-monorepo
description: VizFlow.js monorepo — charts, tables and CLI wizard
author: Alejandro Molina

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @smolina-dev/vizflow-core build && pnpm --filter @smolina-dev/vizflow-cli build && pnpm --filter @smolina-dev/vizflow-studio build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @smolina-dev/vizflow-core test && pnpm --filter @smolina-dev/vizflow-cli test && pnpm --filter @smolina-dev/vizflow-studio test
